text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) secondary to prematurity and maternal diabetes. Given the infant is 32 weeks and has a history of maternal diabetes, surfactant deficiency is the primary concern. REQUEST TEST: Arterial_Blood_Gas. REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_X-Ray.
